articles.summary: TREBLING MAINTENANCE CAPACITY & DOUBLING HIGH-SKILL JOBS Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Tues, 10 Nov) inaugurated its new €40M maintenance facility at Porto Airport. The new 4,900 sqm state-of-the-art 2-bay line maintenance hangar and component workshops adds to Ryanair’s existing 1-bay facility at Porto Airport, trebling the airline’s current maintenance capacity (1 bay to 3 bays). articles.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Thurs, 12 Nov) marked 20 years of operations to/from Malta. Since launching its first two routes from Malta to Luton and Pisa at the end of October 2006, Ryanair has become the island’s largest airline, transforming Malta’s connectivity by offering Maltese citizens/visitors unbeatable choice at the lowest fares in Europe.
